_role: D: rider pressed cancel after driver waited past free wait (6 > 4, below no-show 9)

dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$5.00 for cancelling a few minutes after the driver arrived. The driver was waiting right outside and nothing was wrong with the service, but I feel the fee is too much for such a short time.

chat_logs.content: Hello, I'm at Blk 87 Marine Parade Central, near the void deck.
I'm waiting at the pickup point.
Sorry, my friend just offered to drive me. I'm cancelling.
Trip cancelled by rider. Reason: rider_cancelled. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-3394 booked trip RYDE-CS-005 from Blk 87 Marine Parade Central to Suntec City. Pickup 13:00.
Driver D-5570 (Sumathi d/o Raman, Toyota Corolla Altis (SKZ 7752 U)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 4 min free wait period ends at 13:03.
Free 4-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Cancel pressed by rider R-3394. Reason selected: rider_cancelled.
Cancellation fee S$5.00 charged to rider payment method (credit_card).
Driver D-5570 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_cancelled).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 12:59:00 with GPS at the pickup throughout. The rider pressed cancel at 13:05:00 (cancellation event and system line: cancelled by rider), after the driver had waited 6 minutes, which is past this trip's 4-minute free wait. The fee covers rider cancellations after the free wait; the 9-minute no-show threshold is not needed because the rider, not the driver, cancelled, and the rider's own chat says he had found another lift. The S$5.00 fee is due.
